mentions.name: Human Behavior Theory
mentions.description: A research project developing an original algorithm/theory that explains human behavior from a third-person perspective, organized into six stages: mathematically establishing the best course of action for individuals, explaining common psychological phenomena (narcissism, anxiety, self-doubt, forgiveness), showing it is the fastest way to learn across domains and become a generalist and critical thinker, exploring how society would unfold if everyone became a generalist critical thinker, and applying the theory to leverage India's demographic advantage to become a superpower.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a original algorithm to explain human behavior from 3rd person perspective.
